name: Chat SDK
summary: Chat SDK is an open-source TypeScript library from Vercel for writing one bot or agent and running it on several chat platforms through adapters. It provides type-safe event handlers, JSX cards and streaming of AI responses into chat threads, with pluggable state storage such as Redis.
facts: Slack, Teams, Google Chat, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, GitHub, Linear, GitLab, web
goodFor: One agent deployed to several chat apps
TypeScript teams already using the AI SDK or Next.js
watchOut: Platform features differ; adapters cannot hide every gap
Platform approval and rate limits still apply per channel
